workflow.name: simple_summarization
workflow.description: Simple chain workflow for document summarization

nodes.name: Extract Key Points
nodes.instructions: Read the document and extract the main key points as a bulleted list.

key_points: AI workflows enable complex multi-step processing

nodes.name: Generate Summary
nodes.instructions: Create a concise summary based on the extracted key points.

sample_output.summary: This document explores agentic AI workflows, highlighting their ability to handle complex processing through routing, parallelization, and human oversight. These capabilities enable sophisticated automation while maintaining quality standards.

nodes.name: Quality Check
nodes.instructions: Validate the summary quality. Check for accuracy, completeness, and clarity.

sample_output.feedback: Summary is clear, concise, and captures all key points effectively.
